calibration_unit: Three separate 5-view fits; each estimates shared focal,cx,cy and five poses; no case pooling
initialization: Focal=1.2*max(image dimensions), principal=(size-1)/2, distortion zero; no camera truth or old map
scope: Train marker IDs only; validation IDs do not reach calibrateCamera. Ideal zero-distortion, square-pixel model is a declared acquisition assumption.
